description: The loan of error-negative-amortization (100 000.00 USD, 30 %, ACT/360, 360 months) with the exact payment basis: A = 2 534.91 amortizes the actual-day interest, so a 31-day month whose interest exceeds A posts a negative principal (-48.42 in the first month) instead of NEG_AMORTIZATION, and the balance still reaches zero.
